title: ModernizeMC
description: ModernizeMC is a modpack that aims to provide a fun, lively experience of the game with resource packs, shaders, and mods that make the game more fun, lively, and more interesting!
body:
# ModernizeMC - the modpack to make Minecraft even livelier!

ModernizeMC is a modpack that is designed to make the game even livelier, fun, and more interesting with brand new textures and animations for mobs, shaders bundled with the pack, and optimizations with mods on Fabric!

ModernizeMC is what you want if you are looking for a modpack that makes Minecraft more lively, and fun! Download ModernizeMC today!

We're working on getting ModernizeMC ready for a launch on Tiny Takeover soon! Thank you for your patience as we work to get it on Minecraft 26.1!

**!** ModernizeMC is still in early stages, not everything is perfect, please let us know where possible of any issues. Thank you!

**Are you experiencing issues with ModernizeMC? Tell us more here: https://discord.gg/sbGeqnHeAF**
